notes.title: New Patch Live
notes.content:
Greetings, Vampires.

A new patch is now available to download. This is a small quality of life patch with a handful of significant bug fixes.

Fixed two bugs in the animation & interaction systems, which caused the game to occasionally crash
Fixed an issue where hub levels in the replay menu would not receive a golden border upon full completion
Fixed an issue where enemies wouldn't start patrolling if the player respawned after the defector had walked down stairs in Work For Hire
Fixed issue with locked icon on the door into Pietro's Hideout being shown when it shouldn't

notes.title: Vampire: The Masquerade – Justice Releases February 6!
notes.content:
It's official! Vampire: The Masquerade - Justice will be launching on SteamVR on February 6 for $29.99! A 20% discount will also be available at launch for a limited time, so act fast. Check out the game's most recent trailer below.

[previewyoutube=29aU_H8c1Oc;full][/previewyoutube]

For the first time, PC VR players will travel to Venice on the hunt for their sire's slayer. Sneak across rooftops and use punishing abilities to overcome enemies in a full campaign that takes full advantage of your PC hardware!

You may also be wondering which headsets we will officially support on Steam! We can confirm the following devices are compatible:

Valve Index
 Meta Rift/Rift S
 Meta Quest 1/2/3/Pro Via Link 

Please note that, unfortunately, we will not have support for the HTC Vive and Windows MR controllers, so these headsets will not be supported. 

We can't wait to welcome our PC VR fans to the world of Justice next month!
